name: opencrane-2
description: OpenCrane 2 monorepo: event core, server and supporting libraries.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:deps && npm run lint:unused && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:readmes && npm run lint:links && npm run lint:fixtures && npm run check:package-licences && npm run lint:changelog
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run typecheck:package && npm run typecheck:dev-stack
scripts.visual:screen-tools-access: nice -n 10 npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/capture-screen-tools-access.mjs
scripts.visual:screen-tools-publish: nice -n 10 npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/capture-screen-tools-publish.mjs
scripts.lint:deps: depcruise apps/demo-mcp/src apps/odoo-mcp/src apps/computer/src apps/ops/src apps/server/src apps/web/src libs --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && depcruise apps --config .dependency-cruiser-tests.mjs

scripts.visual:f2-drawers: npm run ng -w apps/web -- build --browser test/overlays-main.ts --ts-config test/tsconfig.live-view.json --output-path dist/overlays --base-href /overlay-fixture/ && node scripts/check-f2-drawers.mjs
